headline: Low Consumption and Tax Burden Already Causing Restaurant Closures in Querétaro
summary: The Querétaro chapter of Canirac, Mexico's restaurant chamber, estimates five to ten establishments have closed or are considering their situation. It cited low consumption and fiscal burden.
why: Restaurants are a labor-intensive part of consumer services. Weak spending and higher taxes can reduce local employment and business investment.
original_headline: Bajo consumo y carga fiscal, ya generan cierres de restaurantes en Querétaro
